notes.title: Update 1.0.30 - 20. April 2020
notes.content:
The new Update 1.0.30 is just released. You can find the changelog below. Furthermore we started a Discord channel for Autobahn Police Simulator games. Here you can join us: https://discord.gg/AQ5tQ68 

Changelog

 Bugs: Fixed enabled matrix freezing the game when driving at certain spots
 Bugs: Fixed traffic cones not being placed down properly and staying in players hands
 Bugs: Mitigated a situation where freeplay would be disabled after finishing the campaign
 Bugs: Characters are now appearing in correct pose when intuition is active
 Bugs: Police van can now perform speed measurements
 Gameplay-Tweaks: Added HUD markers for quest givers (e.g. Hans) to reduce confusion
 Gameplay-Tweaks: Chosen in-vehicle camera modus is now remembered

notes.title: Update 1.0.29 - 4th of March 2020
notes.content:
The newest update 1.0.29 is now online. In addition to the update, we created a Discord server for the Autobahn Police Simulator games. Come join us: https://discord.gg/AQ5tQ68 

Changelog

 Optimization: Improved navigation during tutorial
 Optimization: Memory used for accident photos is properly freed
 Localization: Added Spanish to available languages
 Graphics: Stone thrower's car now opens its trunk again and has a license plate
 Graphics: Fixed sprite size of loading screen button
 Graphics: Fixed broken cars at car dealership
 Colliders: Improved mission colliders to prevent the player from missing the start of a mission
 UI: Added a notification to screenshot mode when a picture is saved
 UI: Indicator to speak to driver was removed while driving
 UI: Removed duplicate notifications
 Bugs: All buttons in the pause menu now close the pause menu when pressing the Cancel button
 Bugs: Fixed missing license plate in cutscene in Mission 09
 Bugs: Fixed issue with pause menu freezing
 Bugs: Disabled picking up pylons when trunk is closed
 Bugs: Mission 07 will now end properly when leaving the area
 Bugs: Fixed unhandled failure case in Mission 13
 Bugs: Disabled being able to change clothes when the locker was still closed
 Bugs: Fixed RTW and firetruck falling from the sky
 Bugs: Fixed achievement conditions of "Newbie" and "Expert"
 Bugs: Fixed stuck RearCamera when leaving the car
 Bugs: Reduced stuck situations in Mission 16
 Bugs: Fixed mixed-up overlays when restarting Mission 16
 Bugs: Improved collision response of concrete barriers
 Bugs: Fixed inoperable shift-changing clock in police station
 Bugs: Relieved situations where all police vehicles are locked when loading a savegame
 Bugs: Fixed issues with NPCs in police station not being at their place when loading a savegame
 Bugs: Fixed stuck character in cutscene in Mission 11
 Bugs: Fixed blocker in the second part of Accident 07
 Other: Driving into civilians will now generate chaos
 Other: Updated credits

notes.title: Update 1.0.26
notes.content:
Changelog - 1.0.26
Here are major changes in this update.

 Game: Improved controls of the cars
 Game: General improvements to performance and loading times
 AI: Improved AI on cars so they do not cause a traffic jam as often anymore
 Graphics: Made the night time brighter
 Graphics: Fixed wrong sitting position of Hans in the police cars
 Graphics: Fixed flying and circling vegetation
 Graphics: Replaced some textures in wrong places
 Graphics: Adjusted position of some traffic signs
 Graphics: Improved LOD models of civilian vehicles
 Audio: Fixed audio settings being reset on start occasionally
 Colliders: Fixed colliders on some street objects
 Colliders: Fixed some invisible colliders on the railing, increasing chaos factor for no reason
 UI: Removed a misleading loading screen hint
 UI: Added percentage loaded to the loading screen
 UI: Added confirmation window when using photo mode to take a snapshot (Saved under Pictures folder)
 Bugs: Fixed an issue with A07 where the mission was not correctly finished when deciding to not search for the vehicle
 Bugs: Removed police cars from the spawn list of the Autobahn
 Bugs: Fixed a crash when using police intuition
 Bugs: Fixed an issue where it was not possible to stop in the blue area marker of some missions
 Bugs: Fixed a bug where it was possible to check a lorry's wheel twice, which caused a blockage
 Bugs: Fixed some issues with quicktime events


We are already working on further update.

notes.title: Coming soon | Rescue HQ - The Tycoon
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/809720/Rescue_HQ__The_Tycoon/

A few days left - our first Tycoon "Rescue HQ" will be released on 28.05.2019!

In Rescue HQ you build, organise, and manage a station for the three emergency departments police, fire brigade, and ambulance. With a limited initial budget, you further develop the HQ, expand your crew with new employees and provide them with all the equipment and vehicles they need.

In addition, Rescue HQ can be extensively modded. Create or download your own assets, maps, and missions via the Steam Workshop and connect with the community!

Add "Rescue HQ - The Tycoon" now to your wishlist!

notes.title: Update 1.0.20
notes.content:
We have just released another update for Autobahn Police Simulator 2. We are still eager to improve the gameplay experience. Here are the patch notes.


 Optimization: Improved performance and reduced client size
 Fixed an error where savegames were permanently corrupted when saving after teleporting while the player character was sitting in the car
 Mission 6, 12, 21 (and sandbox): Fixed an issue where car chases were not aborted after the cars escaped the player
 Fixed an issue where "invisible borders" frequently caused traffic jams at one spot
 Fixed an issue where the police car would fly off a bridge frequently
 The lane changes of AI cars were tweaked to make the traffic more smoothly
 “Sudden Obstacle": Fixed an issue where it was not possible to get all points
 "Rescue from above" and "Reckless Moving into a lane”: Fixed an issue where it was impossible for the player to reach their destination
 Fixed an issue where players could not get the STEAM achievement for getting all improvements from the tech tree
 Fixed some translation errors and character display errors for German and Hungarian
 Fixed an error in which lorries that transport logs were highlighted during police intuition
 Fixed cases in which voice audio was doubly played 
 Fixed an issue where sunlight would shine through the tunnel
 Fixed an issue where the character would clip through ground during an arrest

notes.title: Prepare for next Update
notes.content:
Hello all!

We would like you to know that we are of course still working on Autobahn Police Simulator 2 and the next update. We can’t tell you exactly what will be included but we are still working on improving the performance, fixing mission bugs and updating the navigation system. Next to these points the update will include more major and minor fixes. We are still checking the feedback from your side and try our best to include it into our ToDo list.

We can’t tell you the exact release date for the update but you can be sure that it will come and we are still committed to eliminate all the bugs!


Best regards

The Autobahn Police Simulator 2 team

notes.title: Update 1.0.16
notes.content:
Hello all! 

The latest update is online! It is quite extensive and contains a lot of major and minor improvements. The performance of the game improved further and the handling of the civil police car was overhauled. In addition to this the game has now more music tracks. These are only some examples of the changes this update brings. Of course we will improve the game further and hope that you’ll like the changes!

Here is the full list of changes:


 Missions: PR conferences now always take place in the early noon
 Missions: Improved QTE in M17
 Vehicles: Civil vehicle is no longer incentivizing an emergency lane before the bluelights are toggled once
 Accidents: Sketch does now show the correct vehicle details
 Dialogs: Fixed case where members of the conversation would lean forwards or backwards when the other one is not on the same height
 Free-play: Radio communication now correctly resumes after an mission has been accepted
 Missions: Fixed knocking SFX in M13
 Missions: Toilet can now be entered properly under certain conditions
 Traffic control: Beards are now animated during alcohol tests
 UI: Fixed localization of back button in help menu
 UI: Options menu adjusted to be uppercase
 UI: No longer need to click multiple times in help menu to show item
 Vehicles: Improved visibility of vehicle lights for low-detail models
 Vehicles: Improved handling of civil car
 Vehicles: Disallowed generation of license plates with leading zeroes
 World: Corrected some holes at bridges
 World: Adjusted height of some signs that were too low for trucks to pass them
 World: Changed location of the Huttstaetten fast-travel spot
 World: Improved performance at lakes
 Accidents: Corrected information about vehicles in accident sketches
 Audio: Added new theme for the station
 Audio: Added second theme for normal gameplay
 Audio: Added theme for main menu
 Engine: Upgraded engine version to 2017.2.1p1
 Free-play: pursuits are now triggering correctly
 Graphics: Shading on adjacent road terrains at dusk and dawn now looks correct
 Input: Input configuration file should now be properly read in all cases
 Input: Remapping inputs will now properly persist
 Missions: M10 truck of arrested suspect is no longer driving away
 Missions: M16 convoy is now starting more smoothly
 Missions: M20 pursuit does now fail when suspect left the map
 Missions: Added popup after campaign is over
 Missions: Specific vehicles no longer spawn inside other vehicles on the road
 Performance: Reduced overhead of adjusting several dynamic materials
 Performance: Reduced frequency of garbage collections
 Performance: Removed small lags caused by the playback of collision SFX
 Performance: Improved memory usage by properly unloading procedural meshes during world streaming
 Performance: Disabled static batching to support procedural mesh unloading
 Performance: Removed resource unloading strategy that was too broad and produced lags when unloading streamed world parts
 Performance: Reduced savegame size by a great bit, reducing time needed to save the game
 Traffic Control: Improved positioning of interaction handles of some vehicles
 Traffic Control: When arresting suspects, the jail cutscene is now playing back properly
 Traffic Control: improved vehicle interaction in "Follow Me" matrix mode
 Traffic Control: Alcohol test is now always considered valid as long as the suspect has any blood alcohol percentage above 0
 Traffic Control: Fixed a case where the driver has different looks than the game assumed because the character was not properly initialized
 Tutorials: Fast travel tutorial will no longer pop up after loading a savegame
 UI: Positioning of gamepad button indicators in tech tree view improved
 UI: Mouse cursor is now hidden when using gamepad or steering wheel
 UI: Distance display during convoys or pursuits is now showing a unit
 UI: Changed key binding required to accept a radio call to a different key than required for exiting the car (by default: R on keyboard and the X button on XInput devices)
 Vehicles: Bear Baranga driver characters will no longer sit in the steering wheel after the game is running for a longer time
 Vehicles: Driving backwards no longer stops acceleration
 Vehicles: Enabled functionality of civil vehicle front matrix display
 Vehicles: Vehicles no longer get stuck behind an obstacle and instead try to overtake it
 Vehicles: Vehicles are now reacting more dynamically to emergency situations and build a emergency lane when a vehicle with blue lights enabled approaches
 Vehicles: Exiting the vehicle is no longer possible when the doors are blocked
 Vehicles: When part of a convoy, vehicles will no longer react to the blue lights of the player vehicle
 Vehicles: Reduced aggressiveness of truck acceleration
 Vehicles: Mirrors of the van are now working properly
 Vehicles: Prevented generation of license plates having 0 as the number
 Vehicles: Speed cameras are now back in the trunk after loading a savegame
 Vehicles: Vehicle performance upgrades now work properly after loading a savegame
 Vehicles: Fleeing suspects will no longer honor the blue lights of the player vehicle, making chases more difficult
 Vehicles: Can now switch to a rear view camera by using either the right stick button on gamepads, the right mouse button or the Y key on keyboards (by default)
 World: Traffic lights are now in working condition
 World: Removed some geometry cracks

notes.title: Update 1.0.13
notes.content:
A new update is here! We fixed a lot of bugs and improved performance. And no, we're not finished yet, but we think we're on a good way. When we're back in the office in january we will continue to fix still open issues, further improve performance and begin changing and improving AI behavior.

Here is a Changelog:

Chaos: Capped max chaos given when colliding with other cars to 70%
Chaos: Chaos is no longer disabled after teleportation
Navigation: Improved navigation graph coverage, giving better navigation path results in lots of cases
Performance: Improved AI simulation logic
Physics: Disabled transform auto sync for a slight performance boost
Vehicles: Fixed driverless cars appearing during longer sessions
Vehicles: Improved positioning of rear light emitters of the Bear Baranga
Vehicles: Fixed case where the players vehicles wouldn't properly reset to their parking lots after loading a savegame
Vehicles: Restored mirror rendering
Vehicles: Removed cause for license plates not being replaced correctly when re-spawning a vehicle from the pool
Vehicles: Brake and rear driving lights on unit vehicle and van do work now properly
AI: Removed one-off error causing occasional AI simulation lock-ups
AI: Cars no longer accidentially spawn in "parking" state on highway
Accidents: Objects can't be picked up simultaneously any longer
Cameras: Improved player camera clipping and collision avoidance
Cameras: Player camera now correctly chooses inside/outside mode after loading a save
Characters: Added new available clothin, i.a. merry bag caps
Characters: Fixed regression on player beards not having emotion expressions
Chases: Chased vehicle now properly despawns after arresting the driver
Companion: Added patch code to fix missing Hans as a companion during free play in existing savegames
Cutscenes: Revoked player control during several cutscenes
Cutscenes: Fixed several cases where some NPCs couldn't talk in dialogues after participating in a cutscene
M12: Improved traffic cone positioning to avoid AI not recognizing closed lane properly
M13: Knocking SFX can now be heard
M15: Fixed some gameplay triggers not only reacting to the player or player vehicle, which threw off mission logic in some cases
M16: Arrival trigger now only reacts to the player vehicle and not NPC vehicles anymore, potentially starting the convoy early
M18: Timer is now correctly stopping when arriving, not ticking down during the cutscene anymore
M06: Gave voice to the NPC during interrogation
M19: Improved cleanup after cancelling mission resulting in wrong companion
M20: Restored Hans as companion after finishing the mission
M21: Improved cleanup after cancelling mission resulting in wrong companion
A04: Fixed task resolution during talk to driver
A06: Put flying character to ground
A07: Improved cleanup when cancelling mission
A14: Added new texts for part II
A14: Added target marker to find companion
Performance: Optimized some initialization routines to reduce lags
Performance: Removed a waiting condition in parallel AI code to lock up AI processing, resulting in occassional half-second lags
Performance: Reduced number of recomputations required during AI simulation
Performance: Split up a large background job into multiple smaller jobs to improve throughput
Radio: Trash missions can now be accepted
Radio: Influence points are now only given when actively changing to the right radio state
Traffic Control: Removed loophole allowing you to enter car during control
Traffic Control: Saving no longer allowed after requesting a vehicle to stop to prevent broken savegames
Traffic Control: Name mismatch on driving license and registration certificate no longer requires to call out a warning
Traffic Control: Restored notebook availability during paper control
Traffic Control: Mismatching photo on driving license now warrants an arrest
Traffic Control: Wrong driving class on driving license now warrants an arrest
Traffic Control: Switching through trunk objects is now also possible with keyboard keys
Traffic Control: Same drug quiz answers no longer appear twice
Traffic Control: Captives no longer float on their chairs in the interrogation room
UI: Vignette and notification for chaos don't vanish anymore after opening the pause menu
UI: Added help menu
UI: Changed map icons style to pins to improve representation of true position
UI: Radio calls can no longer be accepted from the pause menu
UI: Improved gamepad control for sliders and scrolling
World: Removed despawners placed at stadium exit crossing
World: Made some world barriers open for AI vehicles
World: Fixed dog food cans stacking up in the stations walls after loading a save
World: Added cutscene when shopping for donuts
World: Fixed several level design issues
Firefly Trooper: Improved trunk contents
Input: Added separate steer and camera sensitivity settings
Logging Truck: Fixed lights
Audio: Ambient SFX improvements

Localization: Added translations for paddle inputs
Shooting range: Improved QTE failure
Shooting range: Doors now block the player
Tech: Fixed people at coffee maker
QTEs: Reduced sensitivity of some quick time actions for better usability

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9
notes.content:
Dear players,

we want to introduce you to our next update, version 1.0.9 - in this version we made lots of improvements, like implementing steering wheels properly into the options menu or improving radio communication during free play. We also made an effort to optimize the game. Unfortunately the version is still suffering from lags on very fast PCs which we can only fix in the next update. Fortunately, the next update will already be published in the next days.

Here are all the changes included in this update:

1.0.9

Added correct manuals
Removed potential blocker in radio state machine when loading a savegame
Accidents: Added helicopter if unlocked
Accidents: Debriefing when leaving accident too early is now correct
Audio: Reduced air turbulence volume whilst driving
Cutscenes: Improved camera shot rendering precision
Dialogs: Improved camera shots
Dialogs: Removed character sliding during dialog
Dialogs: Characters now face each other during conversations
Graphics: Added light to helicopter searchlight
Input: Fixed issue with multiple simultaneously connected XInput devices
Input: Increased input settings file version, requires remapping
Input: Binding of previously unbound actions now works again
Localization: Improved wording of clothes changing tasks
Localization: Current weekday is now properly localized
NPCs: Prevented NPCs falling through floors on slower PCs
Performance: Reduced memory pressure resulting in less garbage collections

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
The first update is released! Sadly we couldn’t fix all the problems within the short time, but we hope that you can enjoy the game better with this patch. This is only the start for several updates which will come in the near future. We're still working on improvements and bugfixes. For this version, we fixed a lot of blockers during missions that we missed during our testing. 
But there have been lots of other, smaller and larger improvements which are noted down in the detailed changelog at the bottom of this post.

Notes
[olist]
If you still have problems with controlling the game, please reset the controls in the option menu. If you made custom adjustments to the controls mapping please check if they still are in place.
Sadly some of you ran into blockers which then were persisted to your save. Sadly we couldn't provide a automated solution to these blockers, so if you can't load your save or your campaign doesn't continue, please get in touch with us and we'll try to fix up your save.
[/olist]

Full changelog

Input: Controller mappings work properly now
Input: Non-XInput devices now have the correct default throttle/brake assignment
Input: Fixed broken input mappings
Input: Removed not supported "Save" button mapping
Game: Removed some superfluous data from savegames
Game: All unlocked vehicles will be reset to their parking lots when a savegame is loaded
Game world: Improved display of telescope in darkness
Game world: small level design improvements
UI: A notification is shown when the game was saved automatically
UI: Pause menu will now close when saved successfully and show a notification
UI: Quitting the game within the pause menu will now ask for confirmation
UI: Main menu is now showing version number in lower right corner
UI: Removed leftover "ghost" of fast travel discovery notification during night
UI: Alignment of "Change camera" help text during paper control is now set properly
UI: Improved localization for input mappings
UI: Replaced background images for main menu and loading screen
UI: Loading screen: New background with logo included
UI: Main menu: Exchanged background image with logo included
Accidents: Changed given influence points balancing
Accidents: Fixed animation for carrying the water ball
Vehicles: Logging trucks are disabled for traffic controls until other issues with the truck are fixed
Vehicles: Civil vehicle matrix animations do now work properly
Vehicles: Semitrucks no longer spawn twisted
Traffic control: Trucks can now carry other cargo than vegetables and also carry different cargo than designated in the cargo papers
Traffic control: Improved positioning of rear camera when checking license plate
Traffic control: Fixed some of the interaction objects placed in cars
Traffic Control: Fixed camera still moveable during truck tire checks
Traffic Control: Fixed placement of driver, license plate and model plate handles during paper control
Graphics: Anti-Aliasing setting is now working
Graphics: Quality setting of water is now dependent on "Details" setting
AI: Worked around complete AI hang-up when offscreen agents despawn on their own
Localization: Character creator head category section titles localized
Player vehicles: Several small texturing/material improvements
NPC Vehicles: Added blob shadows
AI: Improved lane changing path computation resulting in no more ghost drivers on exits and entries
"On the hunt": Fixed possible blocker during vehicle search when interacting with briefcase before trunk opened completely
"Hailstorm of stones": Fixed branch in last dialog where the player is told about the CAVR not depending on actual CAVR unlock state
"Suicide": Improved pylon positioning so the AI won't block the players car
"Suicide": Fixed blackscreen blocker after task "Leave Room"
"Suicide": Fixed fade-out blocker
"Emergency landing": Emergency vehicles now have drivers
"Emergency landing": Removed blocker when failing to stop traffic before the plane lands
"Emergency landing": Improved AI behavior for accident scene
"Emergency landing": Fixed refugee cutscene being played before ramp was lowered
"Emergency landing": Hans is now teleported next to the player for their conversations
"The doughnut robbery": Improved positioning of car during QTE
"The doughnut robbery": Improved last QTE action
"Human trafficking": Improved QTE for releasing the fugitives
"Human trafficking finale": Fixed cleanup after finish
"Rescue from above": Removed blocker when failing to stop traffic
"Holiday stress": Fixed flying handbag
Radio: No longer producing calls for sandbox missions during other urgent missions
Radio: Removed incoming urgent radio calls during missions
Radio: Improved selection of random radio calls
Added graphics device info to version overlay
Photomode: Now working inside vehicles
Photomode: Fixed display of wrong exit button for gamepads
Photomode: Fixed gamepad control help
Achievements: Several fixes
Achievements: Fast Travelling fixed
Audio: Fixed sudden loud ambient SFX near station at tunnel entry
Audio: Increased vehicle engine SFX volumes
Audio: Ambient SFX improvements
Audio: Improved siren sounds on player vehicles
Engine: Upgrade to 2017.2.0p4 to fix memory leak rendering game unusable after an hour of play
